$schema.description: URL of the generated JSON Schema for editor autocomplete and validation. Ignored at runtime.

schemaVersion.description: resource.json shape version. Omit to use the baseline. Auto-migrated toward CURRENT_RESOURCE_VERSION on load in the dev environment.

draft.description: When true, the resource is present in the repo but NOT loaded or served. Use for work-in-progress resources.

kind.description: Where the resource's data comes from. "prisma" (default) is backed by a Prisma model and a schema.ts; "custom" is configuration-only — supply a repository.ts and use the data source "adapter" field for non-Prisma sources. Use "custom" only for config-only resources; for a non-Prisma data source prefer the data source adapter instead.

name.description: Unique resource identifier. Used as the frontend form id and as the default route/id when those are not explicitly set.

model.description: Prisma model name. Required when kind is "prisma"; must be absent when kind is "custom".

openapi.description: OpenAPI metadata for generated endpoints. Supersedes the root-level tag field.

tag.description: OpenAPI tag for grouping generated endpoints.

description.description: Description shown in the OpenAPI spec for this tag group.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the UI sidebar and page headers. Defaults to a title-cased version of "name".

table.description: Database table name override. Defaults to the Prisma model's table name.

idType.description: Data type of the resource's primary key, used to coerce :id route params. Written by codegen from the Prisma model; defaults to "string".

database.description: Name of the datasource this resource uses. Defaults to the project's default datasource.

parent.description: Mount this resource under a parent route instead of at the top level. Only valid on kind:"custom" resources. See ParentRef for the full config.

route.description: Route segment of the parent resource, e.g. "group". The child mounts at <parent.route>/:<parent.param>/<route>.

param.description: Path parameter name carrying the parent id (e.g. "groupId"). Avoid "id" — that is the child's own id in /:id routes.

idType.description: Type of the parent id, used to coerce the path param. Defaults to "string".

sidebar.description: Sidebar visibility and ordering config. Default: shown, alphabetically ordered, ungrouped.

hide.description: When true, this resource is not shown in the sidebar navigation.

position.description: Explicit position number. Lower values appear higher. Resources without a position are sorted alphabetically after positioned entries.

label.description: Override label in the sidebar. Defaults to the resource title.

group.description: Slug of the sidebar group this resource belongs to. Must match a key in sidebarGroups in crouton.json. Resources in the same group are nested under a shared collapsible section.

columns.description: Column definitions as an id-keyed map. Each key becomes the column id. Omit for a columnless resource.

column.description: Prisma model field name. Defaults to "id" when omitted. Override when the resource key differs from the model field.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in forms and table headers. Defaults to a title-cased version of "id".

hiddenInTable.description: When true, this column is not rendered in the list/table view.

hiddenInForm.description: When true, this column is not rendered in the create/edit form.

hiddenInView.description: When true, this column is not rendered in the read-only detail view.

createable.description: When false, this column is excluded from the create form. Useful for system-managed fields.

updateable.description: When false, this column is excluded from the edit form after creation. Useful for immutable fields.

hideLabel.description: When true, the label is hidden in the form (useful for boolean toggles or when the context makes the label redundant).

displayKey.description: Dot-path to display a nested property (e.g. "author.name"). Used when the raw field value is an object.

sortId.description: Overrides which field is sent to the API as the sort key (when the sort column differs from the display column).

enum.description: Name of a shared enum in crouton.enums.json. At load time the loader injects the enum's { value, label }[] into fieldInput.options.values. Use this instead of duplicating the option list on each column.

idField.description: Marks this column as the primary-key field. Exactly one column per resource should set this to true.

unique.description: Enforce that this column's value is unique. true = simple single-column uniqueness; object form allows composite scope, case-insensitive comparison, and a custom message. Requires a matching DB @unique constraint.

scope.description: Other column ids the uniqueness is scoped by (composite unique constraint).

caseInsensitive.description: When true, the uniqueness check is case-insensitive (maps to Prisma mode: "insensitive").

message.description: Custom message shown on the field when the value is already taken.

type.description: Data type of the column. A shorthand string ("string", "integer", "boolean", "date", "date-time", "number", "object", "array") or a JSON Schema fragment. Required on every column of a kind:"custom" resource. On a "prisma" resource this overrides the Prisma-derived type.

required.description: Whether the form requires a value. On a "prisma" resource this overrides the Prisma-derived required state; on "custom" resources it is the only way to mark a field required. Applies to forms only.

relation.description: Sub-resource relation configuration. Prefer this over fieldInput.resource / fieldInput.relationType for new resources.

resource.description: Relative path to the child resource definition (e.g. "./author.resource"). Resolved at load time.

type.description: Cardinality of the relation. Auto-derived from the Zod model or a sibling FK column when omitted.

foreignKey.description: FK field on the child model pointing back to the parent. Defaults to "${parentModel}Id".

prismaField.description: Override the Prisma relation field name when it differs from the column id.

sort.description: Field to sort related records by

fieldInput.description: Configures the UI control used in create/edit forms and the display format. Use "type" to pick the input widget; "format" to pick a special renderer (e.g. "relation").

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for this field-input options block. Enables editor autocomplete for type-specific options.

type.description: Field input type — determines which renderer and options schema apply. Known values: "string" (text), "textarea" (multi-line text), "markdown" (markdown editor), "number" (decimal), "Integer" (whole number), "boolean" (checkbox), "toggle" (toggle switch), "select" (single-select dropdown), "multiSelect" (multi-select), "autocomplete" (relation lookup), "date" (date picker), "dateTime" (date+time picker), "date-range" (date range), "relation" (sub-resource table), "array" (array editor), "custom" (custom renderer). Use "fieldInput.type" to override the display format derived from "columns[*].format".

customRender.description: Import path to a custom Vue component used as the field renderer. Only used when type is "custom".

"oneToMany" or "manyToMany" — collection rendered as a sub-resource table or multi-select. Auto-derived from the Zod model or a sibling FK column when omitted.
